mapper.insert: MERGE INTO REFRESH_TOKEN T USING (SELECT #{memberId} AS MEMBER_ID FROM DUAL) S ON (T.MEMBER_ID = S.MEMBER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.REFRESH_TOKEN = #{refreshToken}, T.EXPIRY_DATE = #{expiryDate} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_ID, REFRESH_TOKEN, EXPIRY_DATE) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{refreshToken}, #{expiryDate})
